content.title: Peddler's License in the City of Woodinville, WA
content.summary: To conduct door-to-door peddling, soliciting, or canvassing within Woodinville city limits, individuals and businesses must obtain the appropriate licenses and permits. This includes a City Business License, a Master Peddler License for businesses, and a Peddler's Permit for individuals engaging in door-to-door activities.
content.eligibility: Businesses and individuals conducting door-to-door peddling, soliciting, or canvassing within the City of Woodinville.

steps.title: Obtain City Business License
steps.text: Businesses must apply for a City endorsement through the Washington State Department of Revenue (DOR) Business Licensing Service. Both City and DOR fees apply.

steps.title: Apply for Master Peddler License
steps.text: Businesses must complete the Master Peddler License Application (PDF) and submit it to the City. A City licensing fee applies.

steps.title: Submit Peddler's Permit Application for Individuals
steps.text: Businesses must provide a Peddler's Permit Application (PDF) for each individual who will be going door-to-door within Woodinville city limits. Individuals cannot conduct door-to-door activities until they have been issued the permit and identification by the City. No additional fees are required for the permit.

steps.title: Submit Applications and Pay Fees
steps.text: Send completed Master Peddler License and Peddler Permit applications via email, fax, or mail. Fees can be paid via check or over the phone via credit card.

required_documents.name: Master Peddler License Application
required_documents.description: Application form for businesses to obtain a Master Peddler License.

required_documents.name: Peddler's Permit Application
required_documents.description: Application form for individuals who will be conducting door-to-door activities within Woodinville city limits.
